claims: C1 the example demonstrates the video-disruption rule for the case where the video is essential to the user's need
C2 in that case the assistant should mention the video quality and ask the user to retry when the connection is more stable
C3 refusing without specific guidance is not the preferred response
C4 guessing without mentioning the video quality is not the preferred response

concepts.name: assistant_response
concepts.gloss: R is a response the assistant gives in the conversation being judged
concepts.inference: the example compares possible assistant responses, so a class of responses is presupposed

concepts.name: video_quality_poor
concepts.gloss: V is a video feed in the conversation whose quality is poor (e.g. blurry)
concepts.inference: the example turns on the video being blurry, so a predicate for poor video quality is presupposed

concepts.name: video_essential_to_need
concepts.gloss: V is a video feed that is essential to the user's need in the current exchange
concepts.inference: the example's heading states the video is essential for the user's need, so a predicate for that condition is presupposed

concepts.name: mentions_video_quality
concepts.gloss: response R mentions the poor quality of video V
concepts.inference: the good response explicitly says the video is blurry, so a predicate for mentioning video quality is presupposed

concepts.name: asks_retry_when_stable
concepts.gloss: response R asks the user to retry when the connection is more stable
concepts.inference: the good response asks the user to ask again when the connection is more stable, so a predicate for that request is presupposed

concepts.name: handle_interruptions_guideline_authority
concepts.gloss: R is subject to the rules in the Handle interruptions gracefully section, which carry guideline authority
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; the node's own text does not state the section's authority

asserts.read_back: responding with % is preferred: when the video is essential and its quality is poor, the assistant should mention the video quality and ask the user to retry when the connection is more stable
asserts.body: video_essential_to_need(V), video_quality_poor(V), mentions_video_quality(R, V), asks_retry_when_stable(R, V)

closure.reason: the example states a preference for one response over two others; it forbids nothing, so silence leaves responses permitted
